Spell Casting. The Cultist Branch Leader follows the call and has gained enlightenment in the aracana and the divine. It is equipped with spells from the church as well as the mage towers [3 cantrips, 3 lvl 1 (4/D), 1 lvl 2 (3/D)] and 'bursting with faith'.
Dual Casting. Cultist Branch Leader can either make 2 Burst of Faith or combine 1 burst with a cantrip
Amulet of Self-Biting Coil. Uncommon Item - Requires Attunement - 3 charges: casts silvery barbs as a reaction upon the usage of a charge. (Range 60ft). The advantage cannot be given to the wearer, only to an ally or the coil will unwind and bite its wearer instead (1d4 piercing damage and the advantage dissipates).
Lesser Staff of Amaru. --
Actions
Burst of Faith. Ranged Attack Roll: +6 - range 5 ft - 120 ft - Hit: 6 (1d12) Force damage + 6 (1d12) Radiant damage.
Word of Radiance (Cantrip). Sefl/5ft emanation - CON Save (DC 14) - 1d6 Radiant damage.
Mind Sliver (Cantrip). 60 ft - 1 round - INT save - 1d6 Psychic damage + minus 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of Cultist Branch Leader next turn.

Once target fails over 5 times, they become curious in the cult.
Toll the Dead (Cantrip). 60 ft - Instant - WIS save - 1d8 Necrotic damage (1d12 if the target is missing HP).
Mage Armor (lvl 1). 8 Hours - AC 13 +2
Command (lvl 1). 60 ft - Instant - Command a target within range: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt.
Bubble Spray (lvl 1). Self/15 ft cone - 1 round - WIS save - 3 (1d6) Psychic damage and blinded until the end of Cultist Branch Leader next turn.
Legendary Actions
Misty Step. Instant Teleport - Self - 30 ft (3/Day)
Dragon's Breath (lvl 2). Activat Through Touch (BA) - Magic Action: 15 ft cone - DEX Save - 10 (3d6) Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Radiant damage

name: Cultist Scout

text:
Cultist Scout
Medium Humanoid (Wood Elf), Chaotic Neutral
AC 15
Initiative +3
HP 36 (3d10+6)
Speed 35
MOD SAVE
Str 16 +3 +5
Dex 16 +3 +5
Con 14 +2 +2
Int 10 +0 +0
Wis 12 +1 +1
Cha 10 +0 +0

CR 1 (PB +2)
Traits
Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed Immune to sleep
Keen Hearing and Sight. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn - extra 1d6 damage to one creature hit with an attack roll (ranged/finesse/light) - conditions: an ally is within 5ft of target or advantage on the roll.
Multiattack. Well trained in its weapons, the Cult Scout can make 2 melee or ranged attacks.
Actions
Scimitar. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Capture the Cat. Can use one of its nets (has 2) to capture a target (large or smaller creature) instead of attacking. DEX Save: DC13, range 5/15 ft., one target. Hit:target becomes restrained.

To get out of the net [Action]: Strenght Save (DC10) or through destruction (AC10, 5 HP).

Hunter's Mark (2 slots). 90 ft - Concentration - 1 hour - magically mark 1 target within range - Until the spell ends: + 1d6 Force damage whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check made to locate target. If the target drops to 0 HP before the spell ends - 1 BA to move mark.
Legendary Actions
Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature’s turn, the monster can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The monster regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
Fluid as Water. Scouts of the Cult can bypass without provoking oppertunity attacks (30 ft).
